player_prompt.intro:
I player {player_id} niin, {colour} ({piece}) hi Othello game ah khel tur a ni.
I tihtur chu, game tawp meka i color piece tam zawk board ah a awm tur a ni.
I turn ah, i piece hi i duh duhna ah dah ang, i opponent piece pakhat chauh ni lo, tam zawk pawh i flank thei ang (horizontally, vertically, emaw diagonally)-i piece thar leh i piece awm sa te inkar ah. I flank thei opponent piece reng reng chu i color ah an flip ang.
I move hi '[row, col]' format ah pe ang.
